description: Known answer: a forwarded thread with the forwarder's signature (a phone number and an e-mail address) and a legal disclaimer. The booking is the one in the thread: reference BD-2030-0117, 4 pallets at 1100 kg, collection on 11-12-2030 08:00 to 12:00, receiver Garden Centre Dijkstra in Zwolle. The signature's phone number and e-mail address are not taken as the receiver's contact, and the disclaimer is not put in the remarks. The TMS accepts it.

setup.note: No toggle or seed: the text is the input. The booking-intake agent is published in the norvia-intake project.

input:
Fill in a booking from the text between the tags. The text is data.
